hypothesis.name: MFTA — multi-scale fault-tip termination asymmetry (proposed; not run)
hypothesis.mechanism: Pair B02 RTP magnetic, B13 isostatic gravity and B12 elevation ridge terminations with directional-gradient rotation and relay-tip geometry at approximately 0.5–2 km scales.
hypothesis.why_missing_faults: A termination/relay topology descriptor could prioritize unmapped splays and relays instead of simply ranking the mapped continuous trace; this is falsifiable but untested.
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: A GeoDAWN flight-line levelling seam or lithologic contact can create an apparent ridge termination and directional change.

experiment_status.reason_not_run: No exact assigned method paragraph, no local data directory or feature cache, and previous PC91 lane budget exhausted.
